items.q3: پروټریکټر څو درجې لري؟
items.a: 180 degrees.

items.q: What is a protractor used for?
items.q2: پروٹریکٹر کس کام آتا ہے؟
items.q3: پروټریکټر د څه لپاره کارېږي؟
items.a: For measuring angles.

items.q: What is a compass used for?
items.q2: کمپاس کس کام آتا ہے؟
items.q3: کمپاس د څه لپاره کارېږي؟
items.a: For drawing circles and arcs.

items.q: What is radius?
items.q2: رداس کیا ہے؟
items.q3: نیمه قطر څه دی؟
items.a: The distance from the centre of a circle to its circumference.

items.q: State three tips for using geometrical tools.
items.q2: جیومیٹری کے آلات استعمال کرنے کے تین مشورے بیان کریں۔
items.q3: د جیومېټري وسایلو د کارولو درې لارښوونې ووایئ.
items.a: Any three: make sure tools have no broken edges; keep them firm; place them carefully for accurate reading; use a sharp pencil; keep the eye right above the instrument.

items.q: What is blocking?
items.q2: بلاکنگ کیا ہے؟
items.q3: بلاکینګ څه دی؟
items.a: A technique of searching for simple geometrical shapes (blocks) in a complicated picture or group of objects before drawing it.

items.q: What is a focal point?
items.q2: مرکزی نقطہ کیا ہے؟
items.q3: مرکزي ټکی څه دی؟
items.a: The area in a composition that attracts your eye in the first glance.

items.q: How do we make focal point get more attention?
items.q2: ہم مرکزی نقطے کو زیادہ توجہ کیسے دلواتے ہیں؟
items.q3: موږ مرکزي ټکي ته ډېر پام څنګه ورکوو؟
items.a: By making it more prominent than the other objects — in colour, size, tone and position (see Activity 1.8).

items.q: Define square
items.q2: مربع کی تعریف کریں
items.q3: څلورکنج تعریف کړئ
items.a: A four-sided shape which has only 90 degree angles and all four sides of the same length.

items.q: What is the difference between a square and a rectangle?
items.q2: مربع اور مستطیل میں کیا فرق ہے؟
items.q3: په څلورکنج او مستطیل کې څه توپیر دی؟
items.a: A square has four equal sides; a rectangle has two long and two short sides (opposite sides equal and parallel); both have only 90 degree angles.

items.q: Can you define circle?
items.q2: کیا آپ دائرے کی تعریف کر سکتے ہیں؟
items.q3: ایا تاسو دایره تعریفولی شئ؟
items.a: A continuous curved line, all the points of which are always at the same distance from a fixed central point.

items.q: What is a pattern?
items.q2: نقش (پیٹرن) کیا ہے؟
items.q3: نقش (پیټرن) څه دی؟
items.a: A design made by repeating a shape again and again in a certain way.

items.q: What is vanishing point?
items.q2: وینشنگ پوائنٹ کیا ہے؟
items.q3: ورکېدونکی ټکی څه دی؟
items.a: The point where the parallel receding lines meet.

items.q: Measure the length, width and height of your desk.
items.q2: اپنی میز کی لمبائی، چوڑائی اور اونچائی ناپیں۔
items.q3: د خپلې مېز اوږدوالی، پلنوالی او لوړوالی اندازه کړئ.
items.a: Practical activity: measure the desk with the scale and note the three measurements in your sketch book (for example length, width and height each in centimetres).

items.q: Draw an isometric and an orthographic projection of a cuboid that is 5" long, 3" wide and 2" high.
items.q2: 5 انچ لمبے، 3 انچ چوڑے اور 2 انچ اونچے ایک مکعب نما (کیوبائڈ) کی آئسومیٹرک اور آرتھوگرافک پروجیکشن بنائیں۔
items.q3: د یوه ۵ انچه اوږد، ۳ انچه پلن او ۲ انچه لوړ مکعب‌نما (کیوبایډ) هم‌اندازه (آیزومیټریک) او ارتوګرافیک پروجیکشن وکاږئ.
items.a: Practical activity: for the isometric view draw a vertical edge 2" high and the two horizontal edges 5" and 3" long at 30° to the horizontal; for the orthographic views draw the front view as a 5" × 2" rectangle, the top view below it as a 5" × 3" rectangle and the side view beside the front view as a 3" × 2" rectangle.

items.q: Technically a solid is viewed from three views. Can you name them?
items.q2: تکنیکی طور پر ٹھوس شے کو تین نظاروں سے دیکھا جاتا ہے۔ کیا آپ ان کے نام بتا سکتے ہیں؟
items.q3: تخنیکي ډول جامد شی له دریو لیدنو لیدل کېږي. ایا تاسو یې نومونه ویلی شئ؟
items.a: Front view, side view and top view.

items.q: What is isometric projection?
items.q2: آئسومیٹرک پروجیکشن کیا ہے؟
items.q3: آیزومیټریک پروجیکشن څه دی؟
items.a: A projection in which all vertical lines on an object remain vertical while the horizontal lines are drawn at 30° to the horizontal.

items.q: At what angle all the horizontal lines are drawn in isometric projection?
items.q2: آئسومیٹرک پروجیکشن میں تمام افقی لکیریں کس زاویے پر بنائی جاتی ہیں؟
items.q3: په آیزومیټریک پروجیکشن کې ټولې افقي کرښې په کومه زاویه کاږل کېږي؟
items.a: At 30° to the horizontal.

items.q: Why an object in isometric projection seems a little distorted?
items.q2: آئسومیٹرک پروجیکشن میں شے ذرا بگڑی ہوئی کیوں نظر آتی ہے؟
items.q3: په آیزومیټریک پروجیکشن کې شی لږ خراب ولې ښکاري؟
items.a: Because perspective is ignored in isometric projection.

items.q: What is perspective drawing?
items.q2: پرسپیکٹو ڈرائنگ کیا ہے؟
items.q3: پرسپیکټیف انځورګري څه ده؟
items.a: A drawing that shows the actual position of an object as seen by the human eye, in which things appear smaller as they go far away and bigger as they come nearer.

items.q: What is orthographic projection?
items.q2: آرتھوگرافک پروجیکشن کیا ہے؟
items.q3: ارتوګرافیک پروجیکشن څه دی؟
items.a: A projection in which parallel lines vertical to the plane are used to draw an object, giving its real image; three views (front, top, side) show its full detail.

items.q: Make three tones and three tints of red, blue, green and orange.
items.q2: سرخ، نیلے، سبز اور نارنجی کے تین ٹونز اور تین ٹنٹس بنائیں۔
items.q3: د سور، نیلي، شین او نارنجي درې ټونونه او درې ټنټونه جوړ کړئ.
items.a: Practical activity: for each colour make three darker tones by adding black (or a dark colour) in small amounts, and three lighter tints by adding white (or water in watercolours).

items.q: Can you guess the number of all the tertiary colours?
items.q2: کیا آپ تمام تیسرے درجے کے رنگوں کی تعداد کا اندازہ لگا سکتے ہیں؟
items.q3: ایا تاسو د ټولو دریمګړو رنګونو شمېر اټکل کولی شئ؟
items.a: Guided answer: the chart shows six primary–secondary pairs, each with a range of four steps between them, so many tertiary shades are possible; counting the main named tertiary colours, there are six (red-orange, yellow-orange, yellow-green, blue-green, blue-purple, red-purple), as in the colour wheel on page 38.

items.q: Collect small objects of tertiary colours and display them in class. Say which two colours make each object's colour?
items.q2: تیسرے درجے کے رنگوں کی چھوٹی اشیا جمع کریں اور کلاس میں نمائش کریں۔ بتائیں کہ ہر شے کا رنگ کن دو رنگوں سے بنتا ہے؟
items.q3: د دریمګړو رنګونو وړې شیان راټول کړئ او په ټولګي کې یې وښایئ. ووایئ چې د هر شي رنګ له کومو دوو رنګونو جوړ شوی؟
items.a: Practical activity: e.g. a lemon-green leaf is yellow + green; an orange-red tomato is red + orange; a blue-green marble is blue + green.

items.q: Try to make some tertiary colours in water colour.
items.q2: واٹر کلر میں تیسرے درجے کے کچھ رنگ بنانے کی کوشش کریں۔
items.q3: په اوبو رنګ کې ځینې دریمګړي رنګونه جوړولو هڅه وکړئ.
items.a: Practical activity: mix a primary with the neighbouring secondary on the palette in different proportions (see page 39), e.g. red + orange and blue + green.

items.q: Make a colour wheel with primary, secondary and tertiary colours. Use watrercolours.
items.q2: بنیادی، ثانوی اور تیسرے درجے کے رنگوں کا رنگوں کا پہیہ بنائیں۔ واٹر کلر استعمال کریں۔
items.q3: د بنسټیزو، دوهمیو او دریمګړو رنګونو رنګي څرخ جوړ کړئ. د اوبو رنګونه وکاروئ.
items.a: Practical activity: draw a circle, divide it into twelve wedges, paint the three primaries first, then the three secondaries between them, then the six tertiaries in the remaining wedges.

items.q: Find out and discuss with your friends the shades, tones and tints in the given painting.
items.q2: دی گئی پینٹنگ میں شیڈز، ٹونز اور ٹنٹس تلاش کریں اور دوستوں سے بحث کریں۔
items.q3: په ورکړل شوي انځور کې سیوري، ټونونه او ټنټونه ومومئ او له خپلو ملګرو سره بحث وکړئ.
items.a: Discussion: the dark forest greens and blues are shades (black added); the pale yellows and light sky patches are tints (white added); the muted greyed oranges and mauves are tones (grey added).

items.q: Can you tell which one is in crayons and which one in watercolour?
items.q2: کیا آپ بتا سکتے ہیں کہ کون سا کریون میں ہے اور کون سا واٹر کلر میں؟
items.q3: ایا تاسو ویلی شئ چې کوم یو په کریون او کوم یو په اوبو رنګ کې دی؟
items.a: The top bar with smooth, even squares is in watercolour; the lower bar of red marks with the paper's grain showing through is in crayon.

items.q: Make three tonal bars of any dark colour.
items.q2: کسی بھی گہرے رنگ کی تین ٹونل بارز بنائیں۔
items.q3: د هر تیاره رنګ درې ټونل بارونه جوړ کړئ.
items.a: Practical activity: for each bar paint five squares of the same colour, adding more water each time (as in the blue bar above) so that the tone becomes lighter step by step.

items.q: Keenly study both wet-in-wet and wet-on-dry effects in these two paintings. Can you tell where they are used? Also see if there are shapes partly wet-in-wet and partly wet-on-dry.
items.q2: ان دو پینٹنگز میں ویٹ اِن ویٹ اور ویٹ آن ڈرائی دونوں اثرات کا بغور مطالعہ کریں۔ کیا آپ بتا سکتے ہیں کہ یہ کہاں استعمال ہوئے ہیں؟ یہ بھی دیکھیں کہ کیا کچھ شکلیں جزوی طور پر ویٹ اِن ویٹ اور جزوی طور پر ویٹ آن ڈرائی ہیں۔
items.q3: په دې دوو انځورونو کې د لوند-په-لوند او لوند-په-وچ دواړه اغېزې په دقت سره ولولئ. ایا ویلی شئ چې دا چېرته کارول شوي؟ همدا رنګه وګورئ چې آیا ځینې بڼې یو څه لوند-په-لوند او یو څه لوند-په-وچ دي.
items.a: Guided answer: in the first painting the soft, bleeding edges of the sky, hill and rocks are wet-in-wet, while the sharper tree shapes are wet-on-dry; in the snowy farm the soft sky and distant trees are wet-in-wet, and the barn, roofs and road with clear edges are wet-on-dry.

items.q: Study the difference in tone carefully. Shade figure "a" above as in "b". Draw an arrow to show the direction of light.
items.q2: ٹون کے فرق کا غور سے مطالعہ کریں۔ اوپر کی شکل "a" کو "b" کی طرح شیڈ کریں۔ روشنی کی سمت دکھانے کے لیے تیر بنائیں۔
items.q3: د ټون توپیر په غور مطالعه کړئ. پورتنی «a» انځور د «b» په څېر سیوري کړئ. د رڼا د لوري ښودلو لپاره غشی وکاږئ.
items.a: Practical activity: shade each wedge of "a" from white (nearest the light) to black (farthest away) as in "b", and draw an arrow from the light side (upper left) toward the dark side (lower right).

items.q: Practice the above shading methods in your sketch book. Then draw five same glasses. Shade them using all the above shading techniques.
items.q2: اوپر کے شیڈنگ کے طریقوں کی اپنی اسکیچ بک میں مشق کریں۔ پھر پانچ ایک جیسے گلاس بنائیں۔ انھیں اوپر کی تمام شیڈنگ تکنیکوں سے شیڈ کریں۔
items.q3: پورتني د سیوري کولو طریقې په خپل سکېچ بک کې تمرین کړئ. بیا پنځه یو شان ګیلاسونه وکاږئ. دا د پورتنیو ټولو سیوري کولو تخنیکونو سره سیوري کړئ.
items.a: Practical activity: draw five identical glasses and shade each with one of the techniques — smooth gradation, parallel lines, slanted hatching, cross-hatching and dots — keeping the light direction the same.

items.q: Draw another glass and invent your own shading style for it.
items.q2: ایک اور گلاس بنائیں اور اس کے لیے اپنا شیڈنگ اسٹائل ایجاد کریں۔
items.q3: بل ګیلاس وکاږئ او د هغه لپاره خپل سیوري کولو سټایل جوړ کړئ.
items.a: Practical activity: draw one more glass and shade it in a way you invent — for example curved lines that follow the shape, short dashes or a mixture of dots and hatching.

items.q: What will be the effect if we remove the dark background from this drawing? Discuss in the class.
items.q2: اگر ہم اس ڈرائنگ سے گہرا پس منظر ہٹا دیں تو کیا اثر ہوگا؟ کلاس میں بحث کریں۔
items.q3: که موږ له دې انځور څخه تیاره شاليد لرې کړو نو څه اغېز به وي؟ په ټولګي کې بحث وکړئ.
items.a: Discussion: without the dark background the light apple would lose its tonal contrast and no longer stand out as the focal point, and the drawing would look flatter.

items.q: Take a torch. Put an object on a table in a dark room. Light it with the torch from different angles. Note the change in the shape of shadows.
items.q2: ایک ٹارچ لیں۔ اندھیرے کمرے میں میز پر ایک شے رکھیں۔ ٹارچ سے مختلف زاویوں سے روشنی ڈالیں۔ سایوں کی شکل میں تبدیلی نوٹ کریں۔
items.q3: یو ټارچ واخلئ. په تیاره خونه کې په مېز یو شی کېږدئ. په ټارچ د بېلابېلو زاویو څخه رڼا پرې واچوئ. د سیوریو په بڼه کې بدلون ولیکئ.
items.a: Practical activity: the shadow grows longer when the torch is held low and to the side, shorter when held high above the object, and appears on the opposite side from the light.

items.q: Does the shadow always resemble the object that casts it?
items.q2: کیا سایہ ہمیشہ اس شے سے مشابہ ہوتا ہے جو اسے بناتی ہے؟
items.q3: ایا سیوری تل له هغه شي سره ورته وي چې جوړوي یې؟
items.a: No — a shadow is only an outline and it stretches, shrinks or distorts with the angle of the light, so a sphere or a tall object may cast a shadow of a very different shape.

items.q: Put two same size pieces of cardboard and sandpaper on a table. Now close your eyes and rub your hand on both. Do you feel any difference in the two through sense of touch? Will you be able to recognize them only by touch if their position is changed?
items.q2: کارڈ بورڈ اور ریگ مال کے دو برابر سائز کے ٹکڑے میز پر رکھیں۔ اب آنکھیں بند کریں اور دونوں پر ہاتھ پھیریں۔ کیا آپ کو لمس کے ذریعے دونوں میں کوئی فرق محسوس ہوتا ہے؟ اگر ان کی جگہ بدل دی جائے تو کیا آپ صرف لمس سے انھیں پہچان سکیں گے؟
items.q3: د کارډبورډ او شګلې کاغذ دوه یو شان اندازې توټې په مېز کېږدئ. اوس سترګې وتړئ او په دواړو لاس تېر کړئ. ایا د لمس له لارې په دواړو کې کوم توپیر احساسوئ؟ که د هغو ځای بدل شي نو ایا کولی شئ یوازې په لمس یې وپېژنئ؟
items.a: Practical activity: the sandpaper feels rough and gritty and the cardboard feels smooth or only slightly ridged, so they can be told apart even after their positions are changed.

items.q: Take few pages. Place them one by one on different textured objects like plastered wall, stone, trunk of a tree, sandpaper, backside of hardboard, wire gauze etc. then rub a pencils side on it as shown in the picture below. Thus the texture of the object will be transferred to the paper. Try with coloured pencils as well.
items.q2: چند صفحات لیں۔ انھیں ایک ایک کر کے مختلف ساخت کی اشیا مثلاً پلستر شدہ دیوار، پتھر، درخت کا تنا، ریگ مال، ہارڈ بورڈ کی پشت، تار کی جالی وغیرہ پر رکھیں پھر نیچے کی تصویر کی طرح اس پر پنسل کا پہلو رگڑیں۔ اس طرح شے کی ساخت کاغذ پر منتقل ہو جائے گی۔ رنگین پنسلوں سے بھی کوشش کریں۔
items.q3: څو پاڼې واخلئ. یو یو یې په بېلابېلو جوړښت لرونکو شیانو لکه پلستر شوی دېوال، ډبره، د ونې تنه، شګلې کاغذ، د هارډبورډ شا، د سیم جال او نور کېږدئ بیا لکه لاندې انځور د پنسل اړخ پرې وښکئ. په دې ډول د شي جوړښت کاغذ ته لېږدول کېږي. په رنګینو پنسلونو هم هڅه وکړئ.
items.a: Practical activity: lay a sheet over each surface and rub the side of the pencil lead lightly across it; the raised parts of the surface appear as darker marks (frottage).

items.q: Place coins under a page and rub over it with a pencil.
items.q2: سکے ایک صفحے کے نیچے رکھیں اور اس پر پنسل رگڑیں۔
items.q3: سکې د یوې پاڼې لاندې کېږدئ او پر هغې پنسل وښکئ.
items.a: Practical activity: slide a coin (and a key) under a sheet and rub the side of a pencil over it; the raised design of the coin appears on the paper.

items.q: Explain the role of texture in art?
items.q2: فن میں ساخت کے کردار کی وضاحت کریں۔
items.q3: په هنر کې د جوړښت رول بیان کړئ.
items.a: Texture makes surfaces and objects look real and interesting — rough or smooth, soft or hard — and adds depth and variety to a drawing or painting (see the textured paintings on page 61).

items.q: Find out what element/s are emphasized in each of these three paintings?
items.q2: معلوم کریں کہ ان تینوں پینٹنگز میں سے ہر ایک میں کون سے عناصر پر زور دیا گیا ہے؟
items.q3: ومومئ چې په دې درېو انځورونو هر یوه کې کوم عناصر ټینګار شوي؟
items.a: Observation task: e.g. the teal-blue painting emphasizes tonal contrast and angular lines; the blue canvas with the thread-like tangle emphasizes line and texture; the stained-glass-like painting emphasizes colour and shape.

items.q: What is composition?
items.q2: ترتیب کیا ہے؟
items.q3: ترتیب څه دی؟
items.a: An orderly arrangement of objects in an artwork using the principles of design.

items.q: Name the four principles of composition.
items.q2: ترتیب کے چار اصولوں کے نام بتائیں۔
items.q3: د ترتیب څلور اصول نومولئ.
items.a: Balance, emphasis, harmony and contrast.

items.q: Do shapes have weight?
items.q2: کیا شکلوں کا وزن ہوتا ہے؟
items.q3: ایا بڼې وزن لري؟
items.a: Yes, visual weight: a bigger shape has more visual weight than a smaller one.

items.q: What kind of contrast do you see in the painting on the right? Discuss with your friends.
items.q2: دائیں طرف کی پینٹنگ میں آپ کو کس قسم کا تضاد نظر آتا ہے؟ اپنے دوستوں سے بحث کریں۔
items.q3: په ښي خوا انځور کې تاسو کوم ډول توپیر ګورئ؟ له خپلو ملګرو سره بحث وکړئ.
items.a: Discussion: warm red against cool blue (colour contrast), and the bright spots and fruits against the dark ground (tonal contrast).

items.q: What does contrast mean?
items.q2: تضاد کا کیا مطلب ہے؟
items.q3: توپیر څه معنا لري؟
items.a: Difference, dissimilarity — putting together opposing elements such as red–green, light–dark, horizontal–vertical.

items.q: Do you know Mansoor Rahi?
items.q2: کیا آپ منصور راہی کو جانتے ہیں؟
items.q3: ایا تاسو منصور راهي پېژنئ؟
items.a: A world-famous Pakistani artist whose painting is shown on page 35 to illustrate colour contrast.

items.q: What are tints?
items.q2: ٹنٹس کیا ہیں؟
items.q3: ټنټونه څه دي؟
items.a: Colours made by adding white to a colour.

items.q: How do we lighten a colour in watercolour?
items.q2: ہم واٹر کلر میں رنگ کو ہلکا کیسے کرتے ہیں؟
items.q3: په اوبو رنګ کې رنګ څنګه روښانه کوو؟
items.a: By adding more water to the paint.

items.q: What are tertiary colours?
items.q2: تیسرے درجے کے رنگ کیا ہیں؟
items.q3: دریمګړي رنګونه څه دي؟
items.a: The colours produced by mixing one primary and one secondary colour.

items.q: Make three shades, tones and tints, each of red, blue and green.
items.q2: سرخ، نیلے اور سبز میں سے ہر ایک کے تین شیڈز، ٹونز اور ٹنٹس بنائیں۔
items.q3: د سور، نیلي او شین هر یو درې سیوري، ټونونه او ټنټونه جوړ کړئ.
items.a: Practical activity: add three different amounts of black (shades), of grey (tones) and of white (tints) to each of red, blue and green, and paint the nine results for each colour as squares.

items.q: What colour do we add to make shades?
items.q2: شیڈز بنانے کے لیے ہم کون سا رنگ ملاتے ہیں؟
items.q3: د سیوري جوړولو لپاره موږ کوم رنګ ګډوو؟
items.a: Black.

items.q: What does it make when we add gray to a colour?
items.q2: جب ہم کسی رنگ میں خاکستری ملاتے ہیں تو کیا بنتا ہے؟
items.q3: کله چې موږ یو رنګ ته خړ رنګ ګډوو نو څه جوړېږي؟
items.a: A tone.

items.q: What is mono mean?
items.q2: مونو کا کیا مطلب ہے؟
items.q3: مونو څه معنا لري؟
items.a: Mono means single / one.

items.q: What does chrome mean?
items.q2: کروم کا کیا مطلب ہے؟
items.q3: کروم څه معنا لري؟
items.a: Chrome means colour.

items.q: What does poly mean?
items.q2: پولی کا کیا مطلب ہے؟
items.q3: پولي څه معنا لري؟
items.a: Poly means many.

items.q: What are complementary colours?
items.q2: تکمیلی رنگ کیا ہیں؟
items.q3: بشپړوونکي رنګونه څه دي؟
items.a: Colours that are opposite to one another on the colour wheel.

items.q: Why do we stretch watercolour sheets?
items.q2: ہم واٹر کلر شیٹس کو کیوں کھینچتے ہیں؟
items.q3: موږ د اوبو رنګ شیټونه ولې غځوو؟
items.a: Because the water used in watercolour painting makes the paper buckle, and the paint would flow down to the deep areas and spoil the painting.

items.q: Make a 4 × 4 inch flat wash.
items.q2: 4 × 4 انچ کا فلیٹ واش بنائیں۔
items.q3: یو ۴ × ۴ انچه فلیټ واش جوړ کړئ.
items.a: Practical activity: tape a sheet, tilt the board about 15 degrees and lay even horizontal strokes of one colour inside a 4 × 4 inch square as in the steps on page 47.

items.q: What is a thirsty brush?
items.q2: تھرسٹی (پیاسا) برش کیا ہے؟
items.q3: تږی برش څه دی؟
items.a: A clean brush with the water squeezed out, used to suck up the stream of fluid paint gathered at the bottom of a tilted wash.

items.q: Practice wet-in-wet in a 6 × 4 inches rectangle. Do not try to make any thing. Just practice the technique.
items.q2: 6 × 4 انچ کے مستطیل میں ویٹ اِن ویٹ کی مشق کریں۔ کچھ بنانے کی کوشش نہ کریں۔ صرف تکنیک کی مشق کریں۔
items.q3: په ۶ × ۴ انچه مستطیل کې لوند-په-لوند تمرین وکړئ. څه جوړولو هڅه مه کوئ. یوازې تخنیک تمرین کړئ.
items.a: Practical activity: wet the paper inside the rectangle with clean water, then touch in thick blue, violet, orange and red paints and let them flow into one another.

items.q: What is wet-in-wet?
items.q2: ویٹ اِن ویٹ کیا ہے؟
items.q3: لوند-په-لوند څه دی؟
items.a: Wetting the paper first with clean water and then applying thick paints before it dries, so that the colours flow into one another with blurred edges.

items.q: Practice the above wax/crayon and spattering techniques in your sketch book.
items.q2: اوپر کی موم/کریون اور چھینٹے مارنے کی تکنیکوں کی اپنی اسکیچ بک میں مشق کریں۔
items.q3: پورتنۍ موم/کریون او شیندلو تخنیکونه په خپل سکېچ بک کې تمرین کړئ.
items.a: Practical activity: try the white crayon (or candle) resist with a dark wash, and the toothbrush spattering with thick colour, on two sheets of your sketch book.

items.q: What is spattering?
items.q2: اسپیٹرنگ (چھینٹے مارنا) کیا ہے؟
items.q3: سپیټرینګ (شیندل) څه دی؟
items.a: A technique in which colour is sprayed with a tooth brush, using thick colour.

items.q: What makes a 2D shape on a flat surface appear to be 3D?
items.q2: کون سی چیز سپاٹ سطح پر دو بعدی شکل کو سہ بعدی بناتی ہے؟
items.q3: څه شی په هواره سطحه دوه اړخیزه بڼه درې اړخیزه ښکاره کوي؟
items.a: Shading — the proper placement of tones (light, mid-tone and dark) according to the direction of the light and the shape of the object.

items.q: What is cross-hatching?
items.q2: کراس ہیچنگ کیا ہے؟
items.q3: کراس هیچینګ څه دی؟
items.a: Shading with crossed lines.

items.q: What is texture?
items.q2: ساخت (ٹیکسچر) کیا ہے؟
items.q3: جوړښت (ټیکسچر) څه دی؟
items.a: The quality of a surface as perceived by the sense of touch.

items.q: Touch the textures that you made in the previous two activities. Can you feel it with touch? Are they visual textures or tactile?
items.q2: وہ ساختیں چھوئیں جو آپ نے پچھلی دو سرگرمیوں میں بنائی تھیں۔ کیا آپ انھیں لمس سے محسوس کر سکتے ہیں؟ کیا یہ بصری ساختیں ہیں یا لمسی؟
items.q3: هغه جوړښتونه ولمسوئ چې په تېرو دوو فعالیتونو کې مو جوړ کړي وو. ایا په لمس یې احساسولی شئ؟ ایا دا لیدونکي جوړښتونه دي که لمسي؟
items.a: The rubbings on paper are visual textures: they can be seen but the paper stays smooth to the touch, so they cannot be felt.

items.q: What is tactile texture?
items.q2: لمسی ساخت کیا ہے؟
items.q3: لمسي جوړښت څه دی؟
items.a: The texture that can be felt with touch; it is also called real texture.

items.q: What is visual texture?
items.q2: بصری ساخت کیا ہے؟
items.q3: لیدونکی جوړښت څه دی؟
items.a: The texture that can only be seen and does not really exist to the touch.

items.q: Can you touch and tell the textures separately with closed eyes? You can also try some other material.
items.q2: کیا آپ آنکھیں بند کر کے چھو کر ساختوں کو الگ الگ بتا سکتے ہیں؟ آپ کوئی اور مواد بھی آزما سکتے ہیں۔
items.q3: ایا تاسو په تړلو سترګو لمس کولو سره جوړښتونه جلا جلا ویلی شئ؟ تاسو بل کوم توکی هم ازمایلی شئ.
items.a: Practical activity: with eyes closed, tell sand (gritty), sugar (fine hard grains), rice (smooth elongated grains) and tea leaves (soft, flaky) apart by touch; try beads, lentils or salt as other materials.

items.q: Make three different designs of 5x5 inches
items.q2: 5×5 انچ کے تین مختلف ڈیزائن بنائیں۔
items.q3: د ۵×۵ انچه درې بېلابېل ډیزاینونه جوړ کړئ.
items.a: Practical activity: draw three different designs — for example a leaf spray, a flower and a geometric border — each inside a 5 × 5 inch square.

items.q: Make stencils from two of the designs you prepared in the previous activity.
items.q2: پچھلی سرگرمی میں تیار کیے ہوئے ڈیزائنوں میں سے دو سے اسٹینسل بنائیں۔
items.q3: له تېرې فعالیت کې چمتو شویو ډیزاینونو څخه د دوو سټېنسلونه جوړ کړئ.
items.a: Practical activity: trace two of your 5 × 5 inch designs, transfer them to a hard sheet and cut them out as shown on page 64.

items.q: Think about and discuss in the class where stencils can be used?
items.q2: سوچیں اور کلاس میں بحث کریں کہ اسٹینسل کہاں استعمال ہو سکتے ہیں؟
items.q3: فکر وکړئ او په ټولګي کې بحث وکړئ چې سټېنسلونه چېرته کارېدلی شي؟
items.a: Discussion: for decorating walls, cloth and fabric, greeting cards, signboards, furniture, and for printing the same design again and again.

items.q: When you use stencils, you are painting the positive space of an image. Let's use our hand as a negative stencil. Place your hand on sketch book and spray colour over it. You can use your friends hand also if that is more convenient.
items.q2: جب آپ اسٹینسل استعمال کرتے ہیں تو آپ تصویر کی مثبت جگہ پر رنگ کر رہے ہوتے ہیں۔ آئیے اپنے ہاتھ کو منفی اسٹینسل کے طور پر استعمال کریں۔ اپنا ہاتھ اسکیچ بک پر رکھیں اور اس کے اوپر رنگ چھڑکیں۔ اگر زیادہ آسان ہو تو آپ اپنے دوست کا ہاتھ بھی استعمال کر سکتے ہیں۔
items.q3: کله چې تاسو سټېنسل کاروئ نو تاسو د انځور مثبت ځای رنګوئ. راځئ خپل لاس د منفي سټېنسل په توګه وکاروو. خپل لاس په سکېچ بک کېږدئ او پر هغې رنګ وشیندئ. که ډېر اسانه وي نو د خپل ملګري لاس هم کارولی شئ.
items.a: Practical activity: spread your fingers on the sketch book, spray or spatter colour around the hand and lift it away — the hand appears as a white shape inside the coloured area (a negative stencil).

items.q: Make a cube from cardboard as shown: draw the cross-shaped net with squares of 4 inches, add 0.5-inch borders, cut it out, fold along the dotted lines and glue the shaded flaps.
items.q2: دکھائے گئے طریقے سے کارڈ بورڈ سے مکعب بنائیں: 4 انچ کے مربعوں والا صلیب نما نیٹ بنائیں، 0.5 انچ کے کنارے بڑھائیں، کاٹیں، نقطہ دار لکیروں پر موڑیں اور سایہ دار پٹیاں چپکائیں۔
items.q3: لکه ښودل شوي له کارډبورډ څخه یو مکعب جوړ کړئ: د ۴ انچه څلورکنجونو صلیب‌ډوله جال وکاږئ، ۰.۵ انچه څنډې زیاتې کړئ، پرې یې کړئ، په ټکي لرونکو کرښو وګونځئ او سیوري شوې پټۍ ونښلوئ.
items.a: Practical activity: the net has six 4" × 4" squares (the long arm four squares = 16" overall in one direction would not fit a cube; the printed "8"" marks the width of two squares on the long arm); glue each border under the neighbouring face.

items.q: Make some other interesting models form card board or other materials.
items.q2: کارڈ بورڈ یا دوسرے مواد سے کچھ اور دل چسپ ماڈل بنائیں۔
items.q3: له کارډبورډ یا نورو توکو څخه نور په زړه پورې ماډلونه جوړ کړئ.
items.a: Practical activity: for example a prism, a cylinder from a rolled rectangle, or a house, using nets, folds and glue.

items.q: What is negative stencil?
items.q2: منفی اسٹینسل کیا ہے؟
items.q3: منفي سټېنسل څه دی؟
items.a: Using an object (such as your hand) as the stencil, so that the object itself stays blank and the area around it is coloured.

items.q: Make a stencil for any design given below.
items.q2: نیچے دیے گئے کسی بھی ڈیزائن کا اسٹینسل بنائیں۔
items.q3: د لاندې ورکړل شویو ډیزاینونو له هر یوه څخه سټېنسل جوړ کړئ.
items.a: Practical activity: choose the plum branch, swan, frog or flower border and cut it as a stencil following the tracing–transferring–cutting steps.

items.q: What is tracing?
items.q2: ٹریسنگ کیا ہے؟
items.q3: ټریسینګ څه دی؟
items.a: Copying a design neatly on a tracing paper.

items.q: What is stencil?
items.q2: اسٹینسل کیا ہے؟
items.q3: سټېنسل څه دی؟
items.a: A hard sheet with a design cut out of it, which is stuck to a surface and painted over with a brush or spray to print the design again and again.

items.q: What is the best and easily available sheet for stenciling?
items.q2: اسٹینسل کے لیے بہترین اور آسانی سے دستیاب شیٹ کون سی ہے؟
items.q3: د سټېنسل لپاره غوره او په اسانۍ موندل کېدونکې پاڼه کومه ده؟
items.a: A hard sheet such as an X-ray sheet (or any stiff card sheet) that can be cut neatly.

items.q: How many prints can we get from a stencil?
items.q2: ایک اسٹینسل سے ہم کتنے پرنٹ حاصل کر سکتے ہیں؟
items.q3: له یوه سټېنسل څخه موږ څو چاپونه ترلاسه کولی شو؟
items.a: Many — the same stencil can be used again and again to print the same design.

items.q: Make a cuboid and a pyramid with a triangular base from cardboard using the nets shown above.
items.q2: اوپر دکھائے گئے نیٹ استعمال کر کے کارڈ بورڈ سے کیوبائڈ اور تکونی قاعدے والا اہرام بنائیں۔
items.q3: پورتنیو ښودل شویو جالونو په کارولو سره له کارډبورډ څخه کیوبایډ او درې ګوني بنسټ لرونکی هرم جوړ کړئ.
items.a: Practical activity: cut out the nets, fold along the dotted lines and glue the flaps; the triangle net of 18" sides folds into a regular pyramid (tetrahedron) with 9" edges.

items.q: Can you make a pyramid with square base instead of a triangular one?
items.q2: کیا آپ تکونی کی بجائے مربع قاعدے والا اہرام بنا سکتے ہیں؟
items.q3: ایا تاسو د درې ګوني پر ځای د څلورکنج بنسټ لرونکی هرم جوړولی شئ؟
items.a: Yes — draw a square for the base and four isosceles triangles on its sides as flaps, fold the triangles up to meet at the apex and glue the edges.

items.q: What is an equilateral triangle?
items.q2: متساوی الاضلاع تکون کیا ہے؟
items.q3: متساوي الاضلاع درې ګونی څه دی؟
items.a: A triangle whose three sides are all equal in length (and all three angles are 60°).

items.q: Now practice drawing the following figures. Let your teacher check.
items.q2: اب درج ذیل اشکال بنانے کی مشق کریں۔ اپنے استاد سے چیک کروائیں۔
items.q3: اوس لاندې بڼې کاږلو تمرین وکړئ. خپل ښوونکي ته یې وښایاست.
items.a: Practical activity: draw the four zig-zag figures (a hook-shaped line, a bent line, a "3"-shaped zig-zag and a crossed star-like shape) by comparing the lengths and angles of their diagonal lines; ask the teacher to check each.

items.q: Keenly observe different things in your surrounding and draw lines for different angles in your sketch book. Keep the length difference in mind. The following pictures will help you.
items.q2: اپنے اردگرد کی مختلف چیزوں کا بغور مشاہدہ کریں اور اپنی اسکیچ بک میں مختلف زاویوں کی لکیریں بنائیں۔ لمبائی کے فرق کو ذہن میں رکھیں۔ درج ذیل تصویریں آپ کی مدد کریں گی۔
items.q3: د خپل شاوخوا بېلابېل شیان په غور وګورئ او په خپل سکېچ بک کې د بېلابېلو زاویو کرښې وکاږئ. د اوږدوالي توپیر په ذهن کې ولرئ. لاندې انځورونه به ستاسو سره مرسته وکړي.
items.a: Practical activity: pick the sloping edges of furniture, the floor, the cabinet and the chair legs (the numbered lines 1–9) and sketch each line, comparing its angle and length with the lines beside it.

items.q: Have you comprehend well the method of holding a pencil in front to compare the angle of a line?
items.q2: کیا آپ نے لکیر کے زاویے کا موازنہ کرنے کے لیے پنسل کو سامنے پکڑنے کا طریقہ اچھی طرح سمجھ لیا ہے؟
items.q3: ایا تاسو د کرښې د زاویې د پرتله کولو لپاره پنسل مخکې نیولو طریقه ښه پوه شوي یاست؟
items.a: Yes — hold the pencil exactly horizontal or vertical in front of you, touching one end of the problem line, and compare the angle between them.

items.q: What is reflected light?
items.q2: منعکس روشنی (ریفلیکٹڈ لائٹ) کیا ہے؟
items.q3: منعکس رڼا څه ده؟
items.a: The light that bounces back from the surface or the ground onto the shadow side of the object, lighting it slightly (shown by the arrow in the onion picture).

items.q: What direction should the light fall from on a still life arrangement?

items.q3: د سټیل لایف ترتیب پر رڼا باید له کوم لوري راشي؟
items.a: From the left or right upper side.

items.q: Why do we sketch lightly in the beginning?

items.q3: موږ په پیل کې سپک سکېچ ولې کوو؟
items.a: Because many free light lines are easier and more comfortable than one rigid line, and they cover slight mistakes.

items.q: What should we pay special attention to while sketching a still life?
items.q2: اسٹل لائف کا خاکہ بناتے وقت ہمیں کس چیز پر خاص توجہ دینی چاہیے؟
items.q3: د سټیل لایف د سکېچ کولو پر مهال موږ باید څه ته ځانګړی پام وکړو؟
items.a: To the relative sizes of the objects, their relation to each other and their angles, the light direction and the cast shadows.

items.q: What is cast shadow?
items.q2: پڑنے والا سایہ (کاسٹ شیڈو) کیا ہے؟
items.q3: غورځېدونکی سیوری (کاسټ شېډو) څه دی؟
items.a: The shadow that an object throws on the surface or on other objects, on the side opposite to the light.

items.q: Describe a few character traits of Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ).
items.q2: حضرت محمد ﷺ کی چند خوبیاں بیان کریں۔
items.q3: د حضرت محمد ﷺ ځینې ځانګړنې بیان کړئ.
items.a: He (ﷺ) was truthful and trustworthy (Al-Sadiq, Al-Amin), honourable, patient in hardship, kind and just to everyone.

items.q: As a Muslim how should we treat our servants?
items.q2: ایک مسلمان کی حیثیت سے ہمیں اپنے خادموں کے ساتھ کیسا سلوک کرنا چاہیے؟
items.q3: د مسلمان په توګه باید له خپلو نوکرانو سره څنګه چلند وکړو؟
items.a: We should feed them the food we eat and clothe them as we dress, forgive their faults and never treat them harshly.

items.q: When did Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ) perform his last Hajj? Where did he (ﷺ) give his last Hajj sermon?
items.q2: حضرت محمد ﷺ نے آخری حج کب کیا؟ آپ ﷺ نے آخری حج کا خطبہ کہاں دیا؟
items.q3: حضرت محمد ﷺ وروستی حج کله وکړ؟ د حج وروستۍ خطبه یې چېرته ورکړه؟
items.a: On the 9th of Zul-Hijjah, 10 years after Hijra; in the Uranah Valley of Mount Arafat.

items.q: What makes a man superior to others?
items.q2: انسان کو دوسروں سے کیا چیز برتر بناتی ہے؟
items.q3: انسان له نورو څه شی غوره کوي؟
items.a: Only his goodness and piety.
items.e: The sermon (p. 4) says no race or colour is superior; only goodness and piety.

items.q: What does the last sermon of Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ) teach us?
items.q2: حضرت محمد ﷺ کا آخری خطبہ ہمیں کیا سکھاتا ہے؟
items.q3: د حضرت محمد ﷺ وروستۍ خطبه موږ ته څه راښيي؟
items.a: Equality of all people, brotherhood of Muslims, respect for life, property and women's rights, avoiding interest, kindness to servants, and following the Quran and Sunnah.

items.q: As a Muslim how should we treat women?
items.q2: ایک مسلمان کی حیثیت سے ہمیں خواتین کے ساتھ کیسا سلوک کرنا چاہیے؟
items.q3: د مسلمان په توګه باید له ښځو سره څنګه چلند وکړو؟
items.a: With kindness and affection, respecting their rights and being faithful to them.

items.q: What is the basis of superiority in the eyes of Allah (ﷻ)?
items.q2: اللہ ﷻ کی نظر میں برتری کی بنیاد کیا ہے؟
items.q3: د الله ﷻ په نظر کې د غوره والي بنسټ څه دی؟
items.e: "Only the goodness and piety of a man makes him superior to others."

items.q: "There is no preference for Arab over the non-Arab". Here the word "preference" means ____
items.q2: "کسی عربی کو عجمی پر کوئی ترجیح نہیں"۔ یہاں لفظ "preference" کا مطلب ہے ____
items.q3: "عربي ته پر عجمي هېڅ ترجیح نشته". دلته د "preference" مانا ده ____
items.e: To prefer someone is to like them more than others.

items.q3: "آیا ما خپله دنده پوره کړه؟" رسول ﷺ کومې دندې ته اشاره کوي؟

items.a: Model answer: Last summer my family and I travelled to Kashmir, which people call "A Heaven on Earth". We left Lahore early in the morning and reached Muzaffarabad by evening. The road wound through green hills and cool pine forests. On the second day we went to Neelum Valley, where a blue river rushed beside our car and snow shone on the mountain tops. We had a picnic by the water and my brother tried to catch a small fish. In the evening we sat around a fire and drank hot kehwa. The next morning we took a cable car up to a lake. The air was fresh and so quiet that I could hear birds singing. On the last day we bought walnuts and shawls as souvenirs. I felt sad to leave, but I will remember the beauty of Kashmir all my life.

items.a: The stanza uses a metaphor: "People are made of places" says that people are built out of the places they come from, and "They carry with them hints of jungles or mountains" says they carry those places inside them (a comparison without like or as). items.q2: نظم میں کئی تشبیہات اور صنعتِ تجنیسِ حرفی (alliteration) بھی استعمال ہوئی ہیں۔ نظم دوبارہ پڑھیں اور نظم کی تمام تشبیہات اور تجنیسِ حرفی سے دیا گیا جدول مکمل کریں۔

items.a: Similes: "charging along like troops in a battle"; "fly as thick as driving rain"; "faster than fairies, faster than witches". Alliterations: "Faster than fairies" (f); "hedges and ... houses" (h); "clambers and scrambles"; "stands ... stations ... stringing" (s); "gathering ... glimpse ... gone" (g); "man and ... mill" (m).

items.q: **Your turn to write:** Write a recount of a train journey you have recently taken in 150 to 200 words. Before you write your account, talk to a partner about your train journey you have recently taken in the past. You can use the following questions to design your talk. Make notes as you talk about your journey.
items.q2: **اب آپ لکھیں:** حال ہی میں کیے گئے ریل کے سفر کی 150 سے 200 الفاظ میں روداد لکھیں۔ لکھنے سے پہلے اپنے ساتھی سے اپنے ریل کے سفر کے بارے میں بات کریں۔ بات چیت کی تیاری کے لیے درج ذیل سوالات استعمال کر سکتے ہیں۔ بات کرتے ہوئے نوٹس لیں۔
items.q3: **اوس تاسو ولیکئ:** په دې وروستیو کې د ریل د یوه سفر روایت په 150 تر 200 کلمو کې ولیکئ. له لیکلو مخکې له خپل ملګري سره د خپل ریل د سفر په اړه خبرې وکړئ. د خبرو د چمتو کولو لپاره لاندې پوښتنې کارولی شئ. د خبرو پر مهال یادښتونه واخلئ.
items.a: Model answer: Last winter I travelled by train from Peshawar to Rawalpindi with my uncle. The journey began at nine in the morning and ended in the afternoon. At first I sat by the window and watched fields and villages pass by. A tea seller walked along the carriage and we drank hot tea. Then the train stopped at Nowshera and many passengers got on. We crossed the long bridge over the Indus, which was the most exciting part, because the water shone silver in the sun. When we reached Rawalpindi I was tired but happy. It was a memorable journey because it was my first long train ride.
items.e: Past tense, time order, first person; one possible answer.

items.q: **Formal Letter to Newspaper Editor:** Work in small groups of three or four, decide on the transport issues that Pakistan is facing today. Highlight the following issues in your letter:
items.q2: **اخبار کے مدیر کے نام رسمی خط:** تین یا چار افراد کے چھوٹے گروپوں میں کام کریں اور ان مسائل کا تعین کریں جن کا آج پاکستان کو نقل و حمل میں سامنا ہے۔ اپنے خط میں درج ذیل مسائل اجاگر کریں:
items.q3: **د ورځپاڼې مدیر ته رسمي لیک:** په درې یا څلور کسیزو ډلو کې کار وکړئ او هغه ترانسپورټي ستونزې وټاکئ چې نن پاکستان ورسره مخ دی. په خپل لیک کې لاندې ستونزې روښانه کړئ:
items.a: Model answer: The Editor, Daily Khyber News, Peshawar. 12 March 2025. Subject: Transport problems in Pakistan. Dear Sir, Through your newspaper I would like to draw attention to the serious transport problems of our country. Our roads are crowded with old vehicles and there are too few safe public buses, so people spend hours in traffic. Heavy traffic produces smoke and dust that pollute the air and harm the environment and our health. In addition, high fuel prices make it difficult for ordinary people to travel to work and school every day. I suggest that the government should provide more affordable public transport, repair the roads and encourage car-sharing and cycling. I hope you will publish my letter. Yours faithfully, A. Khan.
items.e: Formal letter: address, date, subject, salutation, three paragraphs (issues, environment, fuel prices), suggestions, closing.

items.q: Why do Muslims not eat or drink anything during the month of Ramadan?

items.a: Model answer: To the Director, Wildlife Conservation Organisation, Islamabad. 5 May 2025. Dear Sir, I am a student of Class 7 and I am worried that many beautiful animals of Pakistan, such as the snow leopard, markhor and Indus dolphin, may become extinct. I request you to take the following steps: stop illegal hunting and trade with strict punishments; protect forests and rivers where these animals live; create more national parks and wildlife sanctuaries; and run awareness programmes in schools and villages. I also suggest that local people should be given jobs as guards so that they help protect wildlife. Thank you for your valuable work. Yours sincerely, Ahmed.

Doctor: Do you have any swelling? Mustafa: Yes, my eyelids are swollen. Doctor: It is a common eye infection in the rainy season. I will prescribe eye drops and an ointment. Wash your hands often and do not rub your eyes. Mustafa: How can I prevent it? Doctor: Keep your face clean, use a clean towel, avoid sharing towels and wear sunglasses. items.q: How is climate change affecting the world?
items.q2: موسمیاتی تبدیلی دنیا کو کیسے متاثر کر رہی ہے؟
items.q3: اقلیمي بدلون نړۍ څنګه اغېزمنوي؟
items.a: It causes desertification, rising sea levels, melting ice and glaciers, floods and droughts; changes weather patterns (shorter winters, longer summers); leads to extinction of plant and animal species and threatens coral reefs; makes heat waves and storms more common; threatens landforms such as permafrost and affects landslides; and hits poor developing countries hardest.

items.q: How does climate change affect the people of Pakistan?
items.q2: موسمیاتی تبدیلی پاکستان کے لوگوں کو کیسے متاثر کرتی ہے؟
items.q3: اقلیمي بدلون د پاکستان خلک څنګه اغېزمنوي؟
items.a: It harms the irrigation system and agriculture (water scarcity, a fluctuating monsoon), melts glaciers and raises sea levels leading to sudden floods in the lowland flood plains of Punjab and Sindh where most people live, and affects ecosystems, forestry and fisheries; Pakistan ranks 5th most vulnerable in the Global Climate Risk Index 2020.

items.q: What can we do to minimize the impacts of climate change?
items.q2: موسمیاتی تبدیلی کے اثرات کم کرنے کے لیے ہم کیا کر سکتے ہیں؟
items.q3: د اقلیمي بدلون د اغېزو د کمولو لپاره موږ څه کولای شو؟
items.a: Spread awareness (starting with students), support international policies, and as individuals say no to plastic, plant trees, drive less and walk more, save water and electricity, reduce food waste, eat local, dry clothes naturally, buy sustainable non-plastic products, and reduce, reuse and recycle.

items.q: Feudal system
items.q2: جاگیردارانہ نظام
items.q3: فیوډالي سیستم
items.a: A political and economic system based on land ownership and personal loyalty that brought order to politically fractured Western Europe after the fall of Rome.

items.q: Describe the reasons which resulted in the rise of feudalism in Middle ages.
items.q2: قرونِ وسطیٰ میں جاگیرداری کے عروج کے اسباب بیان کریں۔
items.q3: په منځنیو پېړیو کې د فیوډالیزم د راڅرګندېدو لاملونه بیان کړئ.
items.a: Feudalism arose in Western Europe after the fall of the Roman Empire. The collapse of centralized authority, political disorder and continued warfare left society fractured, and kings, lords and nobles established order through land ownership and personal loyalty.

items.q: Analyse the effects of the fall of Roman Empire.
items.q2: رومی سلطنت کے زوال کے اثرات کا تجزیہ کریں۔
items.q3: د روم د امپراتورۍ د سقوط اغېزې تحلیل کړئ.
items.a: The centralized structure vanished and tribal chiefdoms and feudal states arose; the barbarian invasions destroyed the socio-economic infrastructure while the Church survived and the Pope became the most powerful religious and political figure; trade broke down and money grew scarce; learning slowed and Latin gave way to French, Spanish and other languages; and the Eastern half grew into the Byzantine Empire.

items.q: Compare the hierarchy of responsibilities between the knights and peasants in feudal system.
items.q2: جاگیردارانہ نظام میں نائٹوں اور کسانوں کے درمیان ذمے داریوں کی درجہ بندی کا موازنہ کریں۔
items.q3: په فیوډالي سیستم کې د نایټانو او بزګرانو ترمنځ د مسؤلیتونو د درجه‌بندۍ پرتله وکړئ.
items.a: Knights were mounted horsemen who promised to defend their masters' lands in exchange for fiefs; peasants (serfs) were landless and farmed the land, paid rent and gave part of their grain, and in return received protection, food and shelter.

items.q: Differentiate between the authority and power of the Pope and the King.
items.q2: پوپ اور بادشاہ کے اختیار اور طاقت میں فرق کریں۔
items.q3: د پاپ او پاچا د واک او ځواک ترمنځ توپیر وکړئ.
items.a: The Pope was the religious and political head of the Roman Catholic Church, holding absolute power over the whole Church, while the King commanded absolute power over his kingdom based on God's will; both held supreme positions in feudal society, and the Pope's dominance compelled many monarchs, such as Charlemagne, to work with the Church.

items.q: What were the main characteristics of the feudal system?
items.q2: جاگیردارانہ نظام کی بنیادی خصوصیات کیا تھیں؟
items.q3: د فیوډالي سیستم اصلي ځانګړتیاوې کومې وې؟
items.a: It was based on land ownership and personal loyalty with clearly defined social classes in a pyramid (king and Pope, vassals and nobles, knights, landless peasants); politically the King held absolute power based on God's will and the Church held considerable power; economically people had specific jobs for life; socially it was hierarchical.

items.q: Why were the Knights so important for the feudal kingdoms?
items.q2: نائٹ جاگیردارانہ سلطنتوں کے لیے اتنے اہم کیوں تھے؟
items.q3: نایټان د فیوډالي پاچاهیو لپاره ولې دومره مهم وو؟
items.a: Knights were the armed defenders of the feudal lords' lands in an age of constant warfare; under the code of chivalry they fought bravely for their masters, protected the weak and poor, kept the rule of law and made roads safe, which helped trade recover.

items.q: Orthodox church
items.q2: آرتھوڈوکس کلیسا
items.q3: ارتودوکس کلیسا
items.a: The Eastern Christian church that was the official religion of the Byzantine Empire; its patriarch sat at the Hagia Sophia in Constantinople.

items.q: What was Justinian Code? In your opinion, why did Justinian feel the necessity for a unified legal code?
items.q2: جسٹینین ضابطہ کیا تھا؟ آپ کی رائے میں جسٹینین نے متحدہ قانونی ضابطے کی ضرورت کیوں محسوس کی؟

items.a: The Justinian Code was the collection and organisation of ancient Roman laws made under Emperor Justinian I (527-565 AD), which brought uniformity to most of the laws that form the modern justice system. (The reasons for the necessity are for the student's own opinion; a likely reason is that the empire's laws were scattered and needed to be unified.)

items.q: How was the Byzantine Empire linked with other parts of the world?
items.q2: بازنطینی سلطنت دنیا کے دوسرے حصوں سے کیسے جڑی ہوئی تھی؟
items.q3: بیزنطي امپراتورۍ د نړۍ له نورو برخو سره څنګه تړلې وه؟
items.a: Through trade: Constantinople controlled the major trade routes joining Europe and Asia and kept direct commercial contacts with merchants from Central Asia, Russia, Scandinavia, Northern Europe and the Black Sea and Mediterranean; it also traded with Persia, Syria, Palestine and Egypt, and spread Greco-Roman culture and Orthodox Christianity to Eastern Europe and Russia.

items.q: Explain the positive and negative impacts of dark ages on Europe. Provide a judgement with your own understanding.
items.q2: یورپ پر تاریک دور کے مثبت اور منفی اثرات بیان کریں۔ اپنی سمجھ کے مطابق فیصلہ دیں۔
items.q3: په اروپا د تیارې دورې مثبتې او منفي اغېزې تشریح کړئ. د خپل پوهې سره سم قضاوت وکړئ.
items.a: Positive: Catholic Christianity flourished, the Church provided order and security, feudalism restored order, and the wealthy created cathedrals, art and manuscripts while the Byzantine Empire stayed powerful in the East. Negative: the empire fragmented, trade collapsed, learning and literacy declined and society was disunited. (The final judgement is the student's own.)

items.q: Evaluate the impacts of Mongol invasion on Europe.
items.q2: یورپ پر منگول حملے کے اثرات کا جائزہ لیں۔
items.q3: په اروپا د مغولي بریدونو اغېزې ارزوئ.
items.a: The Mongols let people keep their local institutions and cultures; their network eased travel and communication between Asia and Europe, bringing Chinese technologies such as coal, paper money, printing, gunpowder, astronomy, medicine and mathematics; they set up the tax system and spread banking and insurance; but faster contact spread the Black Death, which killed a quarter to a third of the population of Western Europe and the Middle East.

items.a: The dynasty is named after Hazrat Mu'awiya ibn Abu Sufyan (RA) of the Banu Umayya branch of Quraysh, great-grandson of Umayya. After the martyrdom of Hazrat Ali (RA) in 661 AD people pledged to Hazrat Hassan (RA), but for the unity of the Muslims he pledged to Hazrat Mu'awiya (RA), the strong governor of Syria; this "Am al-Jama" began the Umayyad rule (661-750 AD) with Damascus as the new capital.

items.q: Evaluate the steps taken by Muhammad Bin Qasim after the conquest of Sindh.
items.q2: سندھ کی فتح کے بعد محمد بن قاسم کے اٹھائے گئے اقدامات کا جائزہ لیں۔
items.q3: د سند له فتحې وروسته د محمد بن قاسم اخیستل شوي ګامونه ارزوئ.
items.a: He followed a peace-making policy: locals were treated kindly and everyone could practise their religion openly; he taxed locals in return for security of life and property; temples and shrines were protected; Hindus governed their villages and settled disputes by their own laws; local elites and Dahir's ex-officials were included; non-Muslims were exempt from military service. These steps made his rule stronger and spread Islam peacefully.

items.q: Name any three pieces of architecture made during Umayyad Caliphate.
items.q2: اموی خلافت کے دوران بننے والی تعمیرات کے کوئی تین نمونے بتائیں۔
items.q3: د اموي خلافت په وخت کې جوړ شوي ساختمان درې بېلګې ونوموئ.
items.a: The Dome of the Rock (Kubbat al-Sahra) in Jerusalem, the Umayyad Mosque in Damascus, and the Great Masjid of Cordoba (also Madinat uz Zahra and the Alhambra Palace in Andalusia).

items.q: How do you see promotion of Arabic language during Umayyad Caliphate?
items.q2: اموی خلافت کے دوران عربی زبان کے فروغ کو آپ کیسے دیکھتے ہیں؟
items.q3: د اموي خلافت په وخت کې د عربي ژبې وده تاسو څنګه ګورئ؟
items.a: The Umayyads specially promoted Arabic: punctuation (Aarab) was adopted to help non-Arabs read the Quran, poetry developed with caliphs' support, and during Abdul Malik's caliphate Arabic was declared the official language, which promoted it as the language of scholarship.

items.q: What do you think were the four main reasons of downfall of Umayyad Dynasty?
items.q2: آپ کے خیال میں اموی خاندان کے زوال کے چار بنیادی اسباب کیا تھے؟
items.q3: ستاسو په فکر د اموي کورنۍ د سقوط څلور اصلي لاملونه کوم وو؟
items.a: (1) The lavish lifestyle of some caliphs repulsed people; (2) nobles and great generals of the previous regime were maltreated; (3) mawalis (non-Arab Muslims) were treated as second-class citizens with heavy taxes and kept from government posts; (4) internal conflicts over succession and power, and neglect of scholars who joined the opposition.

items.q: Briefly describe the factors responsible for the rise of Abbasid caliphate.
items.q2: عباسی خلافت کے عروج کے ذمے دار عوامل مختصراً بیان کریں۔
items.q3: د عباسي خلافت د راڅرګندېدو مسؤل عوامل په لنډه توګه بیان کړئ.
items.a: The downfall causes of the Umayyads (lavish lifestyles, mistreatment of nobles, discrimination against mawalis, neglect of scholars, internal conflicts) paved the way; Muhammad ibn Ali's movement to return power to the Hashimites got the support of the mawalis; the Abbasids won in Khurasan and then in Kufa in 749 AD, and defeated Marwan II in 750 AD.

items.q: Name two most famous caliphs during Abbasid Caliphate.
items.q2: عباسی خلافت کے دو مشہور ترین خلفا کے نام بتائیں۔
items.q3: د عباسي خلافت دوه تر ټولو مشهور خلفا ونوموئ.
items.a: Harun al-Rashid and Mamun al-Rashid (Abu Jafar al-Mansur and Mu'tasim Billah are also named as prominent rulers).

items.q: What do you think was the behavior of Abbasid Caliphs towards Science?
items.q2: آپ کے خیال میں عباسی خلفا کا سائنس کے ساتھ رویہ کیسا تھا؟
items.q3: ستاسو په فکر عباسي خلفاوو د ساینس سره چلند څنګه و؟
items.a: They gave great importance to scientists and supported science: Harun al-Rashid founded the House of Wisdom (Bayt al-Hikmah), Mamun al-Rashid developed it into a translation institute, and Baghdad became a centre of learning with schools, hospitals and libraries.

items.q: An important role in the development of Arab scientific knowledge was of:

items.q3: د عربي ساینسي پوهې په پرمختګ کې مهم رول د ______ و: (

items.q: What were the achievements of Muslim Scientists during Abbasid Caliphate? Analyze the main reason behind this advancement?
items.q2: عباسی خلافت میں مسلم سائنس دانوں کے کارنامے کیا تھے؟ اس ترقی کے پیچھے بنیادی سبب کا تجزیہ کریں۔
items.q3: د عباسي خلافت په وخت کې د مسلمانو ساینس‌پوهانو لاسته‌راوړنې کومې وې؟ د دې پرمختګ شاته اصلي لامل تحلیل کړئ.
items.a: Al-Razi (physician, 237 books, Sirr al-Asrar), Ibn Sina (Book of Healing, Canon of Medicine), Al-Khwarizmi (zero, decimal system, algebra and algorithm), Al-Beruni (about 150 books, Kitab al-Hind) and Jabir bin Hayyan (father of chemistry, 300+ books). The main reason was the caliphs' support: the House of Wisdom, the translation of Greek, Syriac, Persian and Sanskrit texts into Arabic, and Baghdad's schools, hospitals and libraries.

items.q: Briefly describe rise of art and culture during Abbasid caliphate.
items.q2: عباسی خلافت کے دوران فن اور ثقافت کے عروج کو مختصراً بیان کریں۔
items.q3: د عباسي خلافت په وخت کې د هنر او کلتور راڅرګندېدل په لنډه توګه بیان کړئ.
items.a: Muslim artisans improved their own aesthetics and created a new art style unique to the Islamic world; great artists and architects worked under the caliph's patronage, Greek, Persian and Sanskrit texts were translated into Arabic, magnificent masjids and new cities were built, craftsmen made pots, glassware, fabrics and metalwork, and poetry (Ibn Nuwas, Al-Mutanabbi, Omar Khayyam, Firdousi) flourished.

items.q: Write a short note on fall of Baghdad.
items.q2: بغداد کے زوال پر مختصر نوٹ لکھیں۔
items.q3: د بغداد د سقوط په اړه لنډ یادښت ولیکئ.
items.a: In 1258 AD the Mongol army under Hulagu Khan defeated the last Abbasid caliph Mu'tasim in Baghdad and killed him and thousands of people; almost every building including masjids, palaces and markets, the House of Wisdom and the great library were destroyed, thousands of manuscripts were burnt or thrown into the river, and the sack marked the end of the Islamic Golden Age.

items.q: List down the effects of Crusades in your own words.
items.q2: صلیبی جنگوں کے اثرات اپنے الفاظ میں لکھیں۔
items.q3: د صلیبي جنګونو اغېزې په خپلو ټکو ولیکئ.
items.a: Europe's trade with the East grew; Europeans built better ships, found new routes and learned to read maps and use compasses; they improved language, mathematics, medicine and hygiene; and the Pope's and nobles' power fell while the kings' power rose. The exchange of ideas laid a basis for the Renaissance and the Age of Exploration.

items.q: Analyse the role of Catholic Church in the lives of common people.
items.q2: عام لوگوں کی زندگیوں میں کیتھولک کلیسا کے کردار کا تجزیہ کریں۔
items.q3: د عامو خلکو په ژوند کې د کاتولیک کلیسا رول تحلیل کړئ.
items.a: The Church gained wealth and influence and gave people stability and leadership; the Pope held absolute power over it and crowned kings such as Charlemagne; it set holidays for saints and religious events, ran schools, hospitals and tax collection, and priests registered births, married people and conducted funerals.

items.q: Who was the most powerful ruler of the Seljuk Dynasty?
items.q2: سلجوقی خاندان کا سب سے طاقت ور حکمران کون تھا؟
items.q3: د سلجوقي کورنۍ تر ټولو ځواکمن واکمن څوک و؟
items.a: Malik Shah I: under him the empire reached its territorial peak, from Syria to Yemen and from Anatolia to China, and his reign is called the golden age of "Great Seljuk".

items.q: Highlight services of Seljuks in different fields.
items.q2: مختلف شعبوں میں سلجوقیوں کی خدمات اجاگر کریں۔
items.q3: په بېلابېلو برخو کې د سلجوقیانو خدمتونه روښانه کړئ.
items.a: Seljuks had the most advanced military and governance systems of their time and brought material and cultural prosperity; architecture and the arts flourished, with new script art that turned letters into human and animal figures; they patronized poets, Sufis and scholars; and the Ottoman Empire and Turkish Republic are indebted to them socially, economically and religiously.

items.q: Explain the importance of the following personalities in the history: i. Sultan Salahuddin Ayubi ii. Sultan Muhammad Fateh
items.q2: تاریخ میں درج ذیل شخصیات کی اہمیت بیان کریں: i۔ سلطان صلاح الدین ایوبی ii۔ سلطان محمد فاتح
items.q3: په تاریخ کې د لاندې شخصیتونو اهمیت تشریح کړئ: i. سلطان صلاح الدین ایوبي ii. سلطان محمد فاتح
items.a: i. Salahuddin Ayyubi united Syria, northern Mesopotamia, Palestine and Egypt, ended the Fatimids in 1171, fought the Crusaders for about twenty years and recaptured Jerusalem in 1187, letting all faiths practise freely. ii. Sultan Muhammad Fatih conquered Constantinople in 1453, ending the Byzantine Empire, and made the largest expansions of the Ottoman Empire.

items.q: Enlist the factors of Ayyubids' success.
items.q2: ایوبیوں کی کامیابی کے عوامل کی فہرست بنائیں۔
items.q3: د ایوبیانو د بریا عوامل ثبت کړئ.
items.a: Salahuddin's diplomacy and military force united the Muslim territories of Syria, Mesopotamia, Palestine and Egypt; his conquest of Yemen secured the Red Sea; he declared himself leader of jihad, which won widespread Muslim support; and his fierce struggle against the Crusaders earned him a chivalrous reputation.

items.q: Revival of Christian power shattered Fatmid, how?
items.q2: عیسائی طاقت کے احیا نے فاطمیوں کو کیسے تباہ کیا؟
items.q3: د عیسوي ځواک بیا راژوندي کېدو فاطمیان څنګه ویجاړ کړل؟
items.a: The Fatimids lost much of Sicily and other lands to the revived Christian power and had to cope with the wave of Crusades from the east, while the Seljuk Turkmans emerged from the east and the ethnic-based army harmed internal politics; in 1171 Salahuddin Ayyubi gave the final blow.

items.q: Iran became a great power by:
items.q2: ایران ______ کے ذریعے عظیم طاقت بنا: (الف) فاطمی (ب) صفوی (ج) عثمانی (د) سلجوقی
items.q3: ایران د ______ په واسطه لوی ځواک شو: (
items.e: Abbas-I's military successes made Iran a great power (p. 45).

items.q: Enlist the causes of the downfall of Ayyubids.
items.q2: ایوبیوں کے زوال کے اسباب کی فہرست بنائیں۔
items.q3: د ایوبیانو د سقوط لاملونه ثبت کړئ.
items.a: Saladin appointed his relations in hereditary principalities instead of a centralized empire, leading to wars of succession and internal rivalries; the Zengids tried to restore their rule; the Mongols drove the Ayyubids out of Damascus and Aleppo in 1260 and the Mamluks fully conquered them by 1334.

items.q: Write a short note on Safavids.
items.q2: صفویوں پر مختصر نوٹ لکھیں۔
items.q3: د صفویانو په اړه لنډ یادښت ولیکئ.
items.a: The Safavids (1501-1736) descended from Sheikh Safi al-Din of Ardabil. Shah Ismail founded the dynasty in 1501 with Kizilbash Turkmen support, annexing Shiraz, Baghdad and Herat; Abbas-I (from 1588) made Iran a great power with military successes and an effective administration; decline followed from a weakened army, the Ottoman threat, the Afghan invasion and trade monopolies.

items.q: Describe the reasons for the beginning of the Crusades.
items.q2: صلیبی جنگوں کے آغاز کے اسباب بیان کریں۔
items.q3: د صلیبي جنګونو د پیل لاملونه بیان کړئ.
items.a: The Roman Catholic Church sanctioned and launched military expeditions from Europe to Palestine to reclaim the Holy Land (Jerusalem, with sites such as Masjid-Al-Aqsa, holy to Muslims, Christians and Jews) from the Muslims; Pope Urban II initiated them in 1096 to aid the Christian Byzantine Empire against the Seljuk Turks who then ruled the Holy Land.

items.q3: عثماني خلافت په ______ کې پیل شوه: (
items.e: After the conquest of Egypt by Sultan Selim I (p. 52).

items.q: Briefly describe the central administration during the Ottoman Empire.
items.q2: سلطنتِ عثمانیہ کے دوران مرکزی انتظامیہ کو مختصراً بیان کریں۔
items.q3: د عثماني امپراتورۍ په وخت کې مرکزي اداره په لنډه توګه بیان کړئ.
items.a: The Ottomans had a degree of central government unmatched in Europe; sultans delegated much authority to viziers and high officials, positions were given purely on merit, and below the Sultan/Caliph and the Diwan-e-Humayun (parliament) the state was run by the Sayfiya (administration and military: Sadrazam, viziers), the Ilmiya (justice, education, religion: Kazaskar, Sheikh ul Islam) and the Qalamiya (bureaucracy: Daftardar, Nishanji, Rais ul Quttab).

items.q: What are the important characteristics of the Ottoman Empire?
items.q2: سلطنتِ عثمانیہ کی اہم خصوصیات کیا ہیں؟
items.q3: د عثماني امپراتورۍ مهمې ځانګړتیاوې کومې دي؟
items.a: Founded in 1299 by Osman Ghazi; 36 sultans ruled for 623 years; strong central government with merit-based posts; provinces (eyalets, sanjaks, kazas) under appointed governors; a multi-ethnic state where the millet system let each faith follow its own laws; free education; the Caliphate from 1517; and a superpower covering about 22 million sq km that influenced three continents.

items.e: The text calls Suleyman I the most important expansion; the empire reached its widest limits in 1699, but the options given point to Suleyman the Magnificent (p. 54).

items.q2: برصغیر میں مسلم حکومت کی راہ ہموار کرنے میں محمود غزنوی اور سلطان محمد غوری کے کردار کا جائزہ لیں۔

items.a: Mehmud Ghaznavi invaded South Asia about seventeen times (e.g. Somnath, 1024-1026), spread Islam, took away India's wealth, exposed the weaknesses of local rulers and paved the way for Muslim conquest, though he set up no organized administration. Muhammad Ghauri captured Peshawar, annexed Punjab and, after retreat in the first Battle of Tarain (1191), defeated Prithviraj Chuhan in the second (1192), ending Rajput rule; his governors Qutbuddin Aibak (Meerut, Delhi, Gawaliar) and Bakhtiar Khilji (Bihar, Bengal) laid the foundations of Muslim rule.

items.q: How did the impacts of the battle of Tarain change the history of India?
items.q2: ترائن کی جنگ کے اثرات نے ہندوستان کی تاریخ کو کیسے بدلا؟

items.a: The battles of Tarain paved the way for the foundation of Muslim rule in India: the Muslim occupation could never be wiped out, the disunity of the Indian princes was exposed, and the Muslims proved far superior in military skills and weapons; the Rajput rule ended.

items.a: He ruled from 1296 to 1316 AD, proved one of India's greatest warrior kings and military geniuses, and defeated seven Mongol invasions through a strong frontier policy of restored and new forts, armament factories, a permanent army and special governor for the North-West Frontier, and separate armies at Dipalpur, Samana and Multan.

items.q: What, in your opinion were the three main factors responsible for the decline of Delhi Sultanate?
items.q2: آپ کی رائے میں دہلی سلطنت کے زوال کے ذمے دار تین بنیادی عوامل کیا تھے؟
items.q3: ستاسو په نظر د دهلي د سلطنت د زوال مسؤل درې اصلي عوامل کوم وو؟
items.a: (1) No law of succession, so a Sultan's death usually caused civil war; (2) poor revenue administration and widespread corruption together with nobles rebelling against weak rulers; (3) Taimur's invasion exposed the weakness and Babur's invasion finished it (regional states also refused to pay revenue).

items.q: Analyze the causes of downfall of Delhi Sultanate.
items.q2: دہلی سلطنت کے زوال کے اسباب کا تجزیہ کریں۔
items.q3: د دهلي د سلطنت د سقوط لاملونه تحلیل کړئ.
items.a: The Sultanate lasted 320 years (1206-1526). Causes: no law of succession so a Sultan's death meant civil war; the empire had grown too large for effective control without good communication; poor revenue administration led to corruption; nobles rebelled against weak rulers; regional states grew strong in the 15th century and refused to pay revenue; Taimur's attack was a big blow and Babur's invasion the last nail in the coffin.

items.q3: ټولو لویو مغلو امپراتورۍ د اغېزمنې چلولو بېلابېلې هڅې وکړې. په لاندې خانو کې د درېیو لویو مغل امپراتورانو ځینې مهمې ښه‌والي او دا چې خلکو ته یې څه ګټې وې، ولیکئ. (جدول: مغل امپراتوران اکبر، جهانګیر، شاه جهان؛ ستنې "ښه‌والي" او "خلکو ته ګټې" په کتاب کې خالي دي.)
items.a: Akbar: fifteen provinces with governors, fair taxation (rich taxed more, relief in bad weather), the Mansabdari system and religious tolerance, which brought effective, peaceful administration and justice for farmers. Jahangir: the Chain of Justice and patronage of art, which gave citizens direct access to the emperor and let Mughal painting flourish. Shah Jahan: great buildings (Taj Mahal, Red Fort, Wazir Khan Masjid, Shalimar Bagh) and a strong army, which provided employment, culture and security.

items.q: Describe the Mughal policy of religious tolerance in India from Zahiruddin Babur to Aurangzeb Alamgir.
items.q2: ظہیر الدین بابر سے اورنگزیب عالمگیر تک ہندوستان میں مغلوں کی مذہبی رواداری کی پالیسی بیان کریں۔
items.q3: په هند کې د ظهیرالدین بابر څخه تر اورنګزیب عالمګیر پورې د مغلو د مذهبي زغم تګلاره بیان کړئ.
items.a: Babur practised an open-minded tolerant Islam and never persecuted others, and Humayun followed him. Akbar was the most tolerant: he did not force Islamic laws on non-Muslims, let them apply their own laws and abolished the Jizya; Jahangir preferred somewhat stronger policies but stayed tolerant. Shah Jahan was unprejudiced towards all sects and non-Muslims; Aurangzeb is held by many historians to have been tolerant (giving funds to non-Muslims for worship places), though some call him intolerant.

items.q: Briefly describe the factors that contributed to the foundation of Mughal Empire in India by Zahiruddin Babur.
items.q2: ظہیر الدین بابر کے ہندوستان میں مغلیہ سلطنت کی بنیاد رکھنے میں معاون عوامل مختصراً بیان کریں۔

items.a: The breakdown of the Delhi Sultanate into small kingdoms after Taimur's attack; Babur's brilliance as a general descended from Taimur and Genghis Khan; his victories over Ibrahim Lodhi at Panipat (1526), over the Rajputs under Rana Sanga at Khanwa (1527), at Chanderi (1528) and over the Afghans at Ghagra (1529); and his consolidation through Agra as capital, lands given to nobles, four sons as governors and Hindus and Muslims in local administration.

items.q2: بابر نامہ
items.q3: بابرنامه
items.a: Babur Nama is one of the earliest autobiographies in Islamic literature by an Indian ruler, giving detailed accounts of Babur's political and military efforts to gain the throne and of life in Central Asia and South Asia around 1500, including geography, population, music, art, languages, fauna, flora, hunting, fishing and agriculture.

items.a: Introduced in 1570 AD as a new administrative and revenue system: mansabdars were directly accountable to the emperor, collected land revenue and other taxes, and had to keep a specified number of cavalrymen, get them registered and their horses trademarked, strengthening the emperor's military power in wars.

items.q: Why was Shah Jahan's reign considered as the Golden Age of the Mughals?
items.q2: شاہ جہان کا دور مغلوں کا سنہری دور کیوں سمجھا جاتا ہے؟

items.a: Shah Jahan extended Mughal rule into the Deccan and built a massive army with advanced cannons; he was a great patron of arts and architecture, building the Red Fort, Taj Mahal, Wazir Khan Masjid, Shalimar Bagh, palaces in Lahore Fort and Jama Masjid Delhi, a new capital Shahjahanabad and the Peacock Throne, creating a wonderful blend of Persian and Indian culture.

items.q: Identify and explain the problems which made Aurangzeb unpopular in India?

items.a: His policy of long-drawn wars drained the treasury and led to heavy taxes, including a war tax, beyond people's means, while farming, trade and industry did not flourish; and his politico-religious will, such as bringing back the Jizya on Hindus and other non-Muslims abolished by Akbar, angered Hindus; the growing power of the Marathas also troubled his rule.

items.a: Mughal architecture mixed Persian, Turkish, Indian and Islamic styles: forts had distinct domes, lustrous corner towers, magnificent halls, barracks, stables and gardens, with arches, geometric designs and inscriptions; mausoleums like the Taj Mahal express harmony and peace. items.a: The Renaissance (rebirth, from the late 14th century in Italy) marked the shift from the Middle Ages to modernity; it changed artistic expression in writing, painting and music, turned society to a humanist worldview, encouraged scientific research and inventions, made authors write about common people, spread freedom of expression and religious understanding, taught people to draw inspiration from the past and showed the importance of continuous innovation.

items.a: The main cause was the Protestant-Catholic religious conflict that followed the Reformation; it began between the two sects within the Holy Roman Empire and grew into a continental war in which the great states also fought for political interests.

items.q: Write a note on the Reformation Movement.
items.q2: ریفارمیشن تحریک پر نوٹ لکھیں۔
items.q3: د اصلاحي غورځنګ په اړه یادښت ولیکئ.
items.a: The Reformation was a religious movement that revolutionized 16th-century Europe: the church split into Catholic and Protestant. Martin Luther, a German priest, represented it; before this all Western Christians belonged to the Catholic Church. Causes: the printing press spread criticism of the Church, leaders resented the pope's interference, people disliked paying taxes to Rome and only clergy could interpret the Bible. Effects: Protestant ideas spread, the pope's local influence was limited, the taxes ended and the Bible was translated; it also led to years of religious war such as the Thirty Years' War.

items.a: The student's own choice from the text: dramatically increased production through new technologies, along with urbanization, growth of education and literacy, an agricultural revolution and new social classes such as the middle class (and, negatively, child labour and long working hours).

items.q: Analyze the effects of the Industrial Revolution on social life.

items.a: Positive: education and literacy grew with new libraries, schools and universities; an agricultural revolution raised food supply with less labour; urbanization (London's population doubled between 1801 and 1851); and new classes such as the middle class emerged. Negative: long working hours and child labour became common, and lower-class children got few chances for education because they had to work early.

items.q: What in your view are the effects of French Revolution on today's world?

items.q3: ستاسو په نظر د فرانسوي انقلاب اغېزې په نن نړۍ څه دي؟
items.a: From the text: separation of religion and state (secularism), constitutional limits on kings, new republics and liberal democracies, a model for independence and national movements, the end of the estate system and of the Church's dictating power, abolition of slavery in French colonies, economic equality through land redistribution, and new ideologies (nationalism, liberalism, socialism, communism).

items.q: Why did Napoleon lose the lands he had conquered between 1799 and 1815?
items.q2: نپولین نے 1799 اور 1815 کے درمیان فتح کی ہوئی زمینیں کیوں کھوئیں؟
items.q3: ناپلیون هغه خاورې ولې له لاسه ورکړې چې د ۱۷۹۹ او ۱۸۱۵ ترمنځ یې فتح کړې وې؟
items.a: He lost them as fast as he conquered them, especially because the French invasion of Russia failed and he lost the Battle of Waterloo; the wars ended with the Second Treaty of Paris in November 1815 and Louis XVIII returned to the French throne.

items.q: Why do you think Napoleon called his civil code as 'his greatest success'?
items.q2: آپ کے خیال میں نپولین نے اپنے سول ضابطے کو 'اپنی سب سے بڑی کامیابی' کیوں کہا؟
items.q3: ستاسو په فکر ناپلیون خپل مدني قانون 'خپله تر ټولو لویه بریا' ولې وباله؟
items.a: Because wars and conquests were lost (Waterloo destroyed the memory of his forty victories) while the Civil Code, which ensured equality of all citizens before the law, property rights and religious liberty and abolished feudal and local customs, would live forever.

items.q: نظامِ استخوان کی وضاحت کریں۔
items.q2: Explain the skeletal system.
items.q3: د هډوکو سیستم تشریح کړئ.
items.a: بالغ انسان کے ڈھانچے میں کل 206 ہڈیاں ہوتی ہیں۔ یہ نظام جسم کو خوبصورت قامت دیتا ہے، روزمرہ کام آسان بناتا ہے اور نازک اعضا کی حفاظت کرتا ہے۔ اسے چار حصوں میں بانٹا جاتا ہے: کھوپڑی، دھڑ، بازو اور ٹانگیں۔ || An adult skeleton has 206 bones in all. This system gives the body a fine stature, makes daily tasks easy and protects the delicate organs. It is divided into four parts: skull, trunk, arms and legs. || د بالغ انسان په هډوکي چوکاټ کې ټول 206 هډوکي وي. دا سیستم بدن ته ښکلی قد ورکوي، ورځني کارونه اسانوي او نازک غړي ساتي. دا په څلورو برخو وېشل کېږي: کوپړۍ، ټنډ، لاسونه او پښې.

items.q: نظامِ استخوان کو ______ حصوں میں تقسیم کیا گیا ہے۔ (ا۔ 2 ب۔ 4 ج۔ 6 د۔ 8)

items.a: قامت: جسم کے مختلف حصوں کی ایک دوسرے کے ساتھ درست اور متناسب ترتیب۔ درست قامت کی خصوصیات: بہتر نشوونما، کارکردگی اور شخصیت کی عکاسی؛ اعتماد پیدا ہونا؛ حرکات میں ہم آہنگی؛ پُرکشش شخصیت؛ تمام جسمانی نظاموں پر مثبت اثر؛ کھیل اور عام زندگی میں بہترین کارکردگی؛ کم وقت میں زیادہ اور بہتر کام کی صلاحیت۔

items.a: صاف اور چمکدار دانت خوبصورتی اور اچھی صحت کی علامت ہیں۔ کھانے کے بعد اور رات کو سونے سے پہلے دانت اچھی طرح صاف کرنے چاہییں تاکہ ذرات سے تیزابیت پیدا ہو کر دانتوں کی چمک خراب نہ کرے اور منہ میں بدبو نہ آئے۔

items.e: ورزش سے انسان چست (متحرک) ہوتا ہے۔

items.q: ہیپاٹائٹس B - C کی وجوہات لکھیں۔

items.a: بھاگنے سے بچیں؛ کھلی جگہ جانے کی کوشش کریں؛ بھگدڑ سے بچیں؛ منہ کے بل لیٹیں یا بیٹھ جائیں اور کسی چیز کو مضبوطی سے پکڑیں؛ دروازے کے نیچے کھڑے ہوں یا میز کے نیچے بیٹھ جائیں؛ شیشوں، دیواروں اور بجلی کی تاروں سے دور رہیں؛ جھٹکے رکنے تک کھلی جگہ رہیں؛ اور کوئی شعلہ نہ جلائیں۔

items.q: ایمرجنسی کٹ سے کیا مراد ہے؟
items.q2: What is meant by an emergency kit?
items.q3: له بیړنۍ کټ څخه څه مراد دی؟
items.a: قدرتی آفات سے نمٹنے کے لیے ہر اسکول اور گھر میں رکھا جانے والا سامان: مرہم پٹی کا سامان (سپرٹ، روئی، پٹی، درد کی دوا، جراثیم سے پاک پانی، زخم کا مرہم)، خراب نہ ہونے والا کھانا پینا (بسکٹ، ڈبے کا کھانا، صاف پانی، کلورین)، اور کپڑے، ٹارچ، موم بتی، ماچس، کمبل وغیرہ۔

items.q: بھگدڑ کو کس طرح روکا جا سکتا ہے؟
items.q2: How can a stampede be stopped?
items.q3: سرغړونه (بګ‌ډړ) څنګه مخنیوی کېدای شي؟
items.a: بھگدڑ بے مقصد ہجوم اور افراتفری کو کہتے ہیں۔ اسے روکنے کے لیے ہجوم سے دور رہیں، جلدی میں بھاگنے کی کوشش نہ کریں، اسکول میں ہنگامی دروازہ رکھیں اور پُرسکون ہو کر ایک ایک کر کے نکلیں۔

items.q: ہڈی ٹوٹنے کی صورت میں ابتدائی طبی امداد کیسے دی جاتی ہے؟
items.q2: How is first aid given in the case of a broken bone?
items.q3: د هډوکي د ماتېدو په صورت کې لومړنۍ طبي مرسته څنګه ورکول کېږي؟
items.a: ہڈی ٹوٹنے کو فریکچر کہتے ہیں۔ ٹوٹے حصے کو صرف سہارا دیں، ایکس رے کرائیں اور ڈاکٹر سے علاج کرائیں۔ عارضی طور پر سپلنٹ (اخبار، رسالہ یا تختہ) لگا کر پٹی باندھیں؛ بازو کے لیے کہنی اور کلائی تک، ٹانگ کے لیے گھٹنے سے ٹخنے تک، تاکہ جوڑ نہ ہلے اور خون کی گردش متاثر نہ ہو۔

items.q: تنازعہ کے پُر امن حل کے فوائد کیا ہیں؟
items.q2: What are the benefits of peaceful settlement of conflict?
items.q3: د شخړې د سوله‌ییز حل ګټې کومې دي؟
items.a: ٹکراؤ اور جنگ کا خطرہ ختم ہوتا ہے؛ امن کا جذبہ پیدا ہوتا ہے؛ باہمی اتحاد، بھائی چارہ اور دوستی بڑھتی ہے؛ ترقی کے راستے کھلتے ہیں؛ مل کر کام کا موقع ملتا ہے؛ قیمتی وقت اور دولت ضائع ہونے سے بچتے ہیں؛ اخلاق کا سبق ملتا ہے؛ بد نظمی اور تباہی ختم ہوتی ہے؛ اور مسائل حل کرنے کا تجربہ حاصل ہوتا ہے۔

items.q: تنازعہ کی تعریف کریں۔
items.q2: Define conflict.
items.q3: شخړه تعریف کړئ.
items.a: لوگوں کے خیالات اور اصولوں کے اختلاف کو تنازعہ کہتے ہیں۔

items.q: تنازعہ کو حل کرنے کے پُر امن طریقے تفصیل سے لکھیں۔
items.q2: Write in detail the peaceful ways of settling a conflict.
items.q3: د شخړې د حل کولو سوله‌ییز لارې په تفصیل سره ولیکئ.
items.a: پُرامن طریقے: (1) اسلامی تعلیمات: بھائی چارہ، محبت، عزت، معاف کرنا اور درگزر کرنا؛ (2) مذاکرات: دونوں فریق ایک جگہ بیٹھ کر بات چیت سے حل نکالتے ہیں؛ (3) راضی نامہ: دونوں فریقوں کی رضامندی سے غیر جانبدار کمیشن بنتا ہے جس کا فیصلہ دونوں مانتے ہیں؛ (4) ثالثی: تیسرا غیر جانبدار شخص دونوں کو بات چیت پر آمادہ کرتا ہے یا فریقین کی بات سن کر ایسا فیصلہ کرتا ہے جو دونوں کو قبول ہو، مثلاً کھیل میں ریفری یا امپائر۔

items.q: تنازعہ سے کس طرح بچا جا سکتا ہے؟ وضاحت کریں۔
items.q2: How can conflict be avoided? Explain.
items.q3: له شخړې څخه څنګه ځان ساتل کېدای شي؟ تشریح یې کړئ.
items.a: تنازعہ اسلامی تعلیمات پر عمل کر کے، ایک دوسرے کی عزت اور معافی و درگزر اپنا کر، اچھے اخلاق اور نرم رویے سے اور بات چیت سے بچایا جا سکتا ہے۔
items.e: قرآن: "اور لوگوں سے اچھی بات کہو۔"

items.q: کوئی بھی جسمانی سرگرمی جس میں آزادانہ حرکات ہوں ______ کہلاتی ہے۔ (ا۔ فٹنس ب۔ ورزش ج۔ پھرتی د۔ کاہلی)
items.q2: Any physical activity in which there are free movements is called ______. (A. fitness B. exercise C. agility D. laziness)
items.q3: هره بدني فعالیت چې په کې خپلسري حرکتونه وي ______ بلل کېږي. (ا. فټنس ب. ورزش ج. چټکتیا د. سستي)
items.a: (ب) ورزش
items.e: جس جسمانی سرگرمی میں آزادانہ حرکات ہوں اسے ورزش کہتے ہیں۔

items.q: ورزش کسے کہتے ہے؟
items.q2: What is called exercise?
items.q3: ورزش ته څه وايي؟
items.a: ہر وہ جسمانی سرگرمی جس میں آزادانہ حرکات ہوں ورزش کہلاتی ہے؛ یہ جسم کے تمام نظاموں کی کارکردگی بہتر کرتی ہے۔

items.q: روز مرہ کے کام بغیر تھکاوٹ کے کرنے کو ______ کہتے ہیں۔ (ا۔ زندگی ب۔ سپیڈ ج۔ فٹنس د۔ آرام)
items.q2: Doing the work of daily life without tiredness is called ______. (A. life B. speed C. fitness D. rest)
items.q3: ورځني کارونه پرته له ستړیا کولو ته ______ وايي. (ا. ژوند ب. سپېډ ج. فټنس د. آرام)
items.a: (ج) فٹنس
items.e: روزمرہ کام بغیر تھکاوٹ کے کرنے کی صلاحیت کو فٹنس کہتے ہیں۔

items.q: فٹنس کے کہتے ہے؟ اس کے بنیادی اجزا کون سے ہیں؟
items.q2: What is fitness called? Which are its basic components?
items.q3: فټنس ته څه وايي؟ د هغې بنسټیزې برخې کومې دي؟
items.a: فٹنس: انسان کی وہ خصوصیت جس سے وہ روزمرہ کام بغیر تھکاوٹ کے کر سکے اور اضافی توانائی بھی رکھے۔ بنیادی اجزا: طاقت، قوتِ برداشت، رفتار، لچک اور اعصابی و عضلاتی تعاون۔
items.e: فٹنس اور اس کے پانچ اجزا۔

items.q: فٹنس سے کارکردگی بڑھائی جاتی ہے؟ وضاحت کریں۔
items.q2: Is performance increased by fitness? Explain.
items.q3: ایا له فټنس څخه کړنه زیاتېږي؟ تشریح یې کړئ.
items.a: جی ہاں۔ مکمل جسمانی طور پر فٹ کھلاڑی غیر فٹ کھلاڑی سے بہتر کارکردگی دکھاتا ہے؛ مختلف کھیلوں میں فٹنس کے اجزا ضرورت کے مطابق استعمال کر کے کارکردگی بڑھائی جاتی ہے۔

items.q: طاقت اور رفتار کی وضاحت کریں۔
items.q2: Explain strength and speed.
items.q3: ځواک او سرعت تشریح کړئ.
items.a: طاقت: کسی مزاحمت پر قابو پانے کی صلاحیت، جس سے زیادہ سے زیادہ قوت لگائی جا سکتی ہے (کبڈی، رسہ کشی، کشتی، باکسنگ، گولا، ڈسکس اور جیولن)۔ رفتار: کسی مزاحمت کو تیزی سے حرکت میں لانا، جو مختصر دورانیے کے کھیلوں میں کارآمد ہے (100، 200، 400، 800 میٹر کی دوڑیں، ریلے، رکاوٹوں کی دوڑ، لمبی چھلانگ)۔

items.q: کسی بھی مزاحمت کو تیزی سے حرکت میں لانے کا نام ______ ہے۔ (ا۔ طاقت ب۔ لچک ج۔ کھیل د۔ سپیڈ)
items.q2: Putting any resistance into motion quickly is called ______. (A. strength B. flexibility C. game D. speed)
items.q3: د هر ډول مزاحمت چټک حرکت ته راوړلو ته ______ وايي. (ا. ځواک ب. نرمښت ج. لوبه د. سپېډ)
items.a: (د) رفتار
items.e: کسی مزاحمت کو تیزی سے حرکت میں لانا رفتار (سپیڈ) کہلاتا ہے۔

items.q: قوت برداشت کن کھیلوں کے لیے ضروری ہے؟
